scopedCoverageNotes.text: Local candidate fields for the November 3, 2026 election were checked against the official final general-election roster and 51 actual sample ballots selected through the public Minnesota ballot finder. This covers the 119 identified local candidate fields and all 298 printed names. It is not a census of every precinct or ballot style. School and ward contests apply only to their exact district. Blank write-in spaces are excluded; separately declared write-in candidates have not been independently enumerated. The Chanhassen city fields use an official sample from the Carver County portion of the same whole-city electorate.
